title: AICOUNTLY licence entitlement envelope (aicountly.licence/1)
description: PROPOSAL. What the central licensing backend returns for one customer's (or one subject's) licence for one product. The signature covers the canonical JSON of `document` (docs/LICENCE_ENTITLEMENT_CONTRACT.md §3): sorted keys, no whitespace, no floats, lists for possibly-empty collections. The schema checks shape; the cross-field rules (paid needs licence_id, plan_code and plan_class paid; valid_until after valid_from) are enforced by the consumer's Entitlement::fromDocument and listed in `x-rules`.

value.description: base64 of the 64-byte detached Ed25519 signature

time.description: RFC 3339, UTC, seconds precision, no offset or fraction

customer_id.description: Manage cmp_id as a decimal string

subject.description: set only on a by-subject answer

licence_id.description: Engage licence_ref; required when state is paid

plan_code.description: central catalogue plan code; required when state is paid

x-rules: state = paid requires licence_id, plan_code and plan_class = paid
valid_until, when both are present, is after valid_from
entitlement codes are unique within a document
no floating-point number may appear anywhere in the document
the signed bytes are the canonical JSON of `document` (lib/ice-kit src/Licence/Canonical.php)
